## Key ideas and homework {#fgt2-finish .trig-lesson .application-lesson}

1. Use the maximum, minimum and full period to build the model.
2. Find all solutions in the required interval.
3. Answer in context: heights, clock times and units.

::: {.takeaway}
I can form a trigonometric model and interpret its solutions in context.
:::

Return to the success criterion. Ask students to name one interpretation they had to make after calculating: a full period rather than high-to-low time; strict depth inequality; overnight interval and domain end; or height rather than time for the Ferris wheel.
